natural_body: Deep discounts spike signups +31% but risk renewal. Use tactically with guardrails.

first.rationale: Prioritize a guarded onboarding-simplification experiment: onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and inherited evidence indicates simplification has improved completion, time-to-value, and SMB activation. Verify the onboarding and discount records before committing, because competitor pricing creates urgency but aggressive discounting carries renewal risk and conflicts with the long-term qualified-revenue objective.
